files.description: Hourly weather for the city, September 2025 (720 rows, one per hour in time order, no gaps): observed_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), temp_c (degrees C, one decimal; about 2% empty), rain_mm (one decimal), wind_kmh (whole number), sky (clear, cloudy, fog or rain; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: Make a table of the average temperature with the day of the month (1 to 30) as rows and the sky condition (trimmed, lower case) as columns, rounded to 1 decimal; leave a cell empty where that sky condition did not occur on that day. `result` should be that table.
intended_computation: Read weather_hourly.csv, normalise sky (strip, lower case), and for each day of the month (rows 1-30) and sky condition (columns) give the mean of the non-empty temp_c values of the matching hours, rounded to 1 decimal; a cell is empty when that sky condition did not occur on that day (or only at hours with an empty temperature).
notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
